script_entry.visual_action: Aged linen awakens as faded nautical-map ink draws itself into the fibers.
script_entry.animation_behavior: Internal ink emergence and canvas-fiber micro-motion first; restrained slow dolly out only after map geometry stabilizes.
script_entry.lyric_cue: Miraba el mar desde el fuerte / pensando en ti, mi querida.
music_cues: First vocal phrase establishes fort and remembrance
script_entry.transition: Fluid material continuation into embroidery; no hard cut.

build_notes: Drive-backed production package. Primary hero plate is the scripted visual anchor; motion variants are bounded support states reserved for proof/FX interpolation. No candidate variant is promoted to canonical until moving-proof acceptance.
